info.title: TechBridge Platform Analytics
info.description: Phase 10 read-only role analytics. Current status of creation cohorts; not historical state, online users, payments or inferred support. Existing dashboard field names are retained with explicit authorized scope.

get.description: Requires a normal current full session. No role/owner override, grouping, timezone or arbitrary filter fields are accepted. See platform-analytics.md for source-proof and legacy metric definitions.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Optional only when both bounds are omitted. Canonical UTC timestamp; from inclusive, to exclusive; maximum interval 366 days. Counts creation cohorts by current status, not historical states.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Optional only when both bounds are omitted. Canonical UTC timestamp; from inclusive, to exclusive; maximum interval 366 days. Counts creation cohorts by current status, not historical states.

200.description: Role-authorized analytics from one read-only database snapshot.
